summary: Benign (confidence 0.85). Sign-ins for prof.kaya@aegean.edu originate from Portugal through university VPN vpn-edge-02 on managed device LT-3104 (F4). Rejected impossible-travel, session-replay, anomalous-ASN, password-spray, and VPN-KEV claims were explained as non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 tokens or shared organisational egress; no compromise signal survived critic review.

rejected_claims.reason: critic: premature impossible-travel claim: the TR event is a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15), not the person; the PT sign-ins use university VPN vpn-edge-02 from device LT-3104

rejected_claims.claim: Session-token replay suspected: zero-MFA sign-in on Turkcell with no device while the user is concurrently active on MEO with managed device LT-3104
rejected_claims.reason: critic: replay row is a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15); not a session-token replay

rejected_claims.claim: Suspicious sign-ins from an ASN outside the account's baseline: Turkcell (TR), 1 event(s)
rejected_claims.reason: critic: shared-egress ASN: 202 distinct accounts completed MFA from 193.140.10.21 in the last 30 days (threshold 10); this ASN is the organisation's own exit (shared NAT / mail relay), not a new personal network for the user

rejected_claims.claim: Password spray then success: 193.140.10.21 failed against 54 accounts (60 failures) and later signed in as this user
rejected_claims.reason: critic: 193.140.10.21 looks like shared egress: 202 distinct accounts completed MFA from this IP in the last 30 days (threshold 10); failures across many accounts are expected background noise, not a coordinated spray

rejected_claims.claim: VPN appliance vpn-edge-02 (firmware 22.7R2.8) runs a product listed in CISA KEV (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282, …)
rejected_claims.reason: critic: firmware 22.7R2.8 already includes the fixes for the KEV entries we can version-check (CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282)

rejected_claims.reason: critic: vpn-edge-01 did not carry a sign-in for prof.kaya@aegean.edu; its KEV status is not relevant to this account's exposure

risk.rationale: All suspicious signals for prof.kaya@aegean.edu have been rejected with valid critics: the TR events are non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync tokens (not interactive logins, not session replay, not impossible travel); the Turkcell/193.140.10.21 activity is the organization's shared egress NAT/mail relay with 202 distinct accounts MFA-ing from it (background noise, not spray or a new personal network); the VPN KEV concerns are version-mitigated or irrelevant (vpn-edge-01 had no sign-in for this account; vpn-edge-02 firmware 22.7R2.8 includes the KEV fixes). The sole verified finding F4 (LIKELY 0.5, most sign-ins from PT) is consistent with normal university VPN use from managed device LT-3104 via vpn-edge-02. No confirmed account-takeover chain, no unexplained weak signal, and no data-quality conflicts remain.
